title: The Broken Wolf
author: A. M. Dunmore
blurb: Astrid Marchetti, an exiled storm-caller, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
